groups.sentence: Instructors may prohibit the use of AI in their courses.
Instructors should assign writing in writing-intensive courses to be completed without generative AI.
Generative AI is not permitted in this course.
Students must not use generative AI tools for any work in this course.
Students must not use AI unless the instructor explicitly permits or authorizes it for a specific assignment or purpose.
Students must not use AI at any stage of their work, including brainstorming, drafting, outlining and editing.
Students complete all submitted work independently, without AI assistance.
Students may use AI tools where course policy permits it.
Students must not use AI on graded work, assessments, exams or work submitted for evaluation.
Using prohibited AI on assignments is academic dishonesty or misconduct.
Instructors may set course rules that ban AI use and expect students not to use it.
Neither instructors nor students use AI tools in this course.
